configurations.name: pixel-lab-files
runtimeArgs: const http=require("http"),fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const ROOT=path.resolve("work/pixel-lab");const T={".mp4":"video/mp4",".png":"image/png",".jpg":"image/jpeg",".html":"text/html",".txt":"text/plain; charset=utf-8",".wav":"audio/wav"};http.createServer((q,s)=>{const f=path.join(ROOT,decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0]));if(!f.startsWith(ROOT)||!fs.existsSync(f)||fs.statSync(f).isDirectory()){s.writeHead(404);return s.end("not found")}const n=fs.statSync(f).size,ty=T[path.extname(f)]||"application/octet-stream",r=/bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(q.headers.range||"");if(r){const a=r[1]?+r[1]:0,b=r[2]?+r[2]:n-1;s.writeHead(206,{"Content-Type":ty,"Content-Range":`bytes ${a}-${b}/${n}`,"Accept-Ranges":"bytes","Content-Length":b-a+1});fs.createReadStream(f,{start:a,end:b}).pipe(s)}else{s.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":ty,"Accept-Ranges":"bytes","Content-Length":n});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(s)}}).listen(3220,"127.0.0.1",()=>console.log("pixel-lab files on http://127.0.0.1:3220"));
